behavioral_notes.observation: Selecting a quotation template on a sale.order clears existing order_line (Command.clear()) then materialises one sale.order.line per sale.order.template.line via line._prepare_order_line_values() (product_id, product_uom_qty, product_uom_id, display_type, is_optional, sequence, optional name); the first real line is forced to sequence -99 so a resequence on page 1 does not mix in page-2 lines. This is the core 'instantiate a quotation from a template' behaviour and lives entirely in Python, not metadata. _onchange_partner_id re-runs it for unsaved orders whose lines still equal the template lines.

Optional products are not a distinct model here: a sale.order.line is optional when it sits under an optional (sub)section (sale.order.line._is_line_optional walks parent_id/display_type). The public jsonrpc controller CustomerPortal.portal_quote_option_update (/my/orders/<int>/update_line_dict) lets a customer add / remove (1 unit) / set the quantity of an optional line on their own quotation from the portal, guarded by access_token via _document_check_access and _can_be_edited_on_portal; for combo products it syncs the linked combo-item line quantities, and protects discount/price_unit while writing product_uom_qty. This is the optional-product add-to-order flow the app layer contributes on top of the sale engine.

behavioral_notes.element: sale.order template compute cascade + action_confirm override
behavioral_notes.observation: Template fields propagate onto the sale.order through overridden @api.depends('sale_order_template_id') computes: note (terms), require_signature, require_payment, prepayment_percent, validity_date (today + number_of_days), journal_id, and confirmation _get_confirmation_template returns the template mail_template_id. action_confirm is overridden so that when an order is confirmed from the backend (send_email=False) and the template carries a mail_template_id, that confirmation mail is sent via _send_order_notification_mail. Template constrains require_payment to 0 < prepayment_percent <= 1.0 and forbids cross-company products on a shared template.

behavioral_notes.element: digest/onboarding glue (digest.digest KPI + Sales app menu hooks)
behavioral_notes.observation: This application module wires the Sales app into the periodic digest and onboarding: digest.digest gains kpi_all_sale_total / kpi_all_sale_total_value computed from sale.report (state not in draft/cancel/sent, sum price_total, date field) plus a _compute_kpis_actions link to sale.report_all_channels_sales_action under sale.sale_menu_root; data/digest_data.xml enables the KPI by default and adds two digest.tips (configurable products, product matrix). post_init_hook activates and uninstall_hook deactivates the 'sale' module ir.ui.menu entries, and pre_init_hook pre-creates the sale_order_template_id column to avoid recompute on existing SOs -- i.e. this module is what actually surfaces the Sales application menu/app.

4 JS files, 2 XML templates, 0 OWL components; 2 registry registrations (fields:so_template_line_o2m widget for editing template lines, public.interactions:sale_management.sale_update_line_button portal interaction driving the optional-line +/- buttons); 2 patches (SaleOrderLineListRenderer.prototype, SaleOrderLineProductField.prototype) extending the sale order line list/product field; asset bundles web.assets_backend (fields), web.assets_frontend (interactions), web.assets_tests (tours), web.assets_unit_tests.

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: sale_management is the application bundle that turns the sale order engine into the Sales app, sitting in the Marketing & Sales primary activity of the value chain and supporting quote creation/revision (APQC 3.5.3 manage sales orders / 3.5.3.14 revise quote). It adds reusable quotation templates that materialise sale.order.line[], portal optional-product selection, and the digest KPI + Sales menu that present the app. It produces no new downstream document of its own; the confirmed sale.order it helps build flows downstream (stock delivery, account invoice) through the parent sale engine.

standard_capabilities: reusable quotation templates with lines, sections/subsections and optional lines
one-click instantiation of a quotation from a template
template-driven defaults: validity, online signature/payment, prepayment %, terms, confirmation mail, invoicing journal
customer self-service add/remove of optional products on the portal quotation
per-company default quotation template + settings feature gate
Sales digest KPI (period sales total) and onboarding tips, Sales app menu
typical_fits: standardised quotations for repeatable offers / catalogues
upsell via optional products selectable by the customer in the portal
online quote signature & prepayment to auto-confirm orders
common_gaps: complex template selection logic (eligibility, channel/website-specific templates)
approval thresholds or discount governance on template-generated lines
richer optional-product / cross-sell recommendation logic beyond flat optional lines

curl jsonrpc /my/orders/<id>/update_line_dict (auth=public, needs access_token + line_id of an optional line)
